issues.legal_issue: Whether sufficient cause was shown to condone the delay in filing the appeal against the decree.
Whether a person who was not a party to the suit may obtain leave to appeal where the decree adversely affects that person’s rights or interests.
Whether rejection of an application for impleadment, where that rejection was not challenged, by itself bars a transferee pendente lite from seeking leave to appeal against the final decree.
Whether, in considering leave to appeal, the appellate court must assess whether the decree would bind the transferee pendente lite or preclude a later challenge to its correctness.
Whether a transferee pendente lite may seek leave to appeal against a decree passed against the transferor under Section 146 of the Code of Civil Procedure.
Whether a transfer made during the pendency of litigation is void or instead remains subject to the rights determined in that litigation, including when made in breach of an injunction.
Whether a transferee pendente lite is entitled to be impleaded or to obtain leave to appeal as a matter of right.
